PS7c fix B1, PD-LOSAT-NCBI-DEFECTS approved exception 30: gapped lambda 4e-9 (raw X-drops past Int4, which NCBI's kernels raise to the gap costs): NCBI's bisection of the cutoff score adds 876829330 and 1753658660 past Int4 (signed overflow; its x86-64 build wraps to the cutoff -832239653 and goes on: NCBI under gdb, fix round 1); LOSAT's bisection in 64 bits gives the cutoff 1689538156: no hits either, NCBI's bytes

PS7c fix B1, PD-LOSAT-NCBI-DEFECTS approved exception 30: gapped lambda 1e-9: NCBI's doubling of the cutoff score passes Int4 and never ends (probes b1, b1b: rc 124 under timeout); LOSAT's search in 64 bits gives a cutoff above 2^31 - 1, which no score reaches: no hits, the bytes of NCBI's run with lambda 8e-9 (outfmt 7 prints no Lambda) | ncbi-near: db.ps7c.tbn.lambda_8e-9

PS7c fix B1, PD-LOSAT-NCBI-DEFECTS approved exception 30: gapped lambda -0.5 (review batch v, l_neg): the e-value grows with the score, so NCBI's doubling of the cutoff score passes Int4; its x86-64 build wraps the bound to INT_MIN, whose e-value is 0, and goes on with the cutoff 2^30 (NCBI under gdb, fix round 1); LOSAT's search in 64 bits finds no score of the e-value, a cutoff above every Int4 score: no hits either, NCBI's bytes
